items.meta: 1 min over this question's 15 min budget

blocks.text: 2 questions and 25 min of plan left. Wrap up with what you have, or ask the short variant.
At 150% (22.5 min) a second card arrives, marked urgent.

msgs.what: When the interviewer moved to Q2 the dashboard sent the plan's remainder along with the question. This is what the pace card quotes later.

`QuestionChanged` gains `at` (now), `remaining_questions` and `remaining_minutes`. The graph resets `question_started_at`, the pace alerts sent, the stuck marker and the difficulty cards for the new question.
Thirty-two ticks later. Each tick enqueues `Tick(at=now)` like any other ingress event; it joins whatever batch is open.
Runs through `apply_events` with the current code context attached.

msgs.l: pace_alert: 16 min elapsed vs 15 min budget
msgs.what: Budget is `question_plan.time_minutes × 60`; elapsed is `at` minus `question_started_at`. Thresholds: `over` at 100%, `far_over` at 150%. The highest one due and not yet sent for this question fires. No budget on the plan means no pacing at all.
Id `sess-7f3a:q2:pace:over`, so it cannot repeat for this question. On the last planned question the body says so instead of quoting the remainder.
